race.comment: Very tricky. CRYPT (6) is a lightly raced gelding who won well from back in the field at Geelong, solid again last time when well backed at Bendigo. He can improve again and finds a winnable race with even luck from the inside gate. ILLUMINANCE (7) continues to race very well without winning, now 2 from 24. Again he added to the minor placings last start at Seymour and the draw should see him tracking the speed with every chance. SMART LITTLE MISS (9) was much better second up at Sandown Lakeside when running into third. She goes well third up and should be ready to peak. CROCODILE (4) resumes for the Maher yard. He'll probably need a bit further than this but has run well in stronger company.
